import numpy as np, json, torch
meta = json.load(open('/work/fwd_4/meta.json'))
ids = meta['token_ids']; lengths = meta['lengths']
H23 = np.load('/work/fwd_4/hidden_L23.npy').astype(np.float32)
H24 = np.load('/work/fwd_4/hidden_L24.npy').astype(np.float32)
mlp23 = np.load('/work/fwd_4/mlp_act_L23.npy').astype(np.float32)
W23 = load('model.language_model.layers.23.mlp.down_proj.weight').float().numpy()
def ao(ti, p):
    return H24[ti, p] - H23[ti, p] - mlp23[ti, p] @ W23.T
coll = [ao(0,443), ao(0,473), ao(2,424), ao(2,401), ao(2,377)]  # para3/4? use 2 waits
heal = [ao(1,389), ao(3,369)]
mc = np.stack(coll).mean(0); mh = np.stack(heal).mean(0)
d = mc - mh
print('|mc|', np.linalg.norm(mc).round(2), '|mh|', np.linalg.norm(mh).round(2), '|d|', np.linalg.norm(d).round(2))
print('cos(mc,mh)', (mc@mh/np.linalg.norm(mc)/np.linalg.norm(mh)).round(3))
E = load('model.language_model.embed_tokens.weight').float().numpy()
gamma = load('model.language_model.norm.weight').float().numpy()
def rv(t): return E[t]*gamma
for name,t in [('think',248069),('imend',248046),('Based',27775),('The',760),('Wait',13784),('\\\\',59),('a',264)]:
    r = rv(t)
    print(f'dot(d, {name}) = {d@r:+.2f}   |r|={np.linalg.norm(r):.2f}   cos={d@r/np.linalg.norm(d)/np.linalg.norm(r):+.3f}')
# also cos of d with normed mc and mh
dn = d/np.linalg.norm(d)
print('cos(d,mc)', dn@mc/np.linalg.norm(mc), 'cos(d,mh)', dn@mh/np.linalg.norm(mh))

save_edit(name, edit_tensor)
